rationale: The protobuf field was renamed from speed_mps to speed_kph with a unit change from meters/second to kilometers/hour. All producer uses (construction), consumer uses (field access), and observations must be migrated. The threshold 30.0 m/s becomes 108.0 km/h (30 * 3.6). The request['speed'] remains in m/s per the intended behavior, so it must be scaled by 3.6 before assignment to the new speed_kph field. The observation key changes from speed_mps to speed_kph, exposing the decoded float32 value directly as a JSON number.
assumptions: The generated Python bindings have been regenerated from the new proto schema, so VehicleTelemetry.speed_kph exists and VehicleTelemetry.speed_mps no longer exists.
The request['speed'] input continues to be provided in meters per second as stated in the intended behavior.
The wire format field number 2 remains float32; only the field name and semantic units changed.
No other files in this change set require edits; the scope is limited to this single Python runtime file.
